'''December 2000 Oxford tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Oxford, NC on 9 December 2000. It is known from Ivan Kanner's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1563">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-20-12-9-00-mara-jade-tourney-oxford-ncd1563/ 12-9-00-mara-jade-tourney-oxford-nc], DeckTech (Ivan "ZippyDaJedi" Kanner, 20 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-20-12-9-00-mara-jade-tourney-oxford-ncd1563/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Oxford, NC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 24
